metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji in December 2020 lower than in any other December from 2005 to 2015?

data.raw_code: The question is asking: "Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji in December 2020 lower than in any other December from 2005 to 2015?" This means I need to: 1. Calculate mean NDSI for Mount Fuji in December 2020 2. Calculate mean NDSI for Mount Fuji for each December from 2005-2015 3. Compare if the 2020 value is lower than ALL the 2005-2015 values NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) For Landsat: typically bands 3 (Green) and 6 (SWIR) Strategy: - Use Landsat collection (Landsat 5, 7, 8 for 2005-2015, Landsat 8 for 2020) - Define Mount Fuji geometry (point or small polygon) - Filter by December dates for each year - Calculate NDSI for each image, then mean NDSI for each December - Compare 2020 mean with all 2005-2015 means Data quality checks: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after masking (C2) - Validate NDSI values are reasonable (-1 to 1) (C3) Output: A (Yes) if 2020 < all 2005-2015, B (No) otherwise ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mountFuji = ee.Geometry.Point([138.7278, 35.3606]); // Mount Fuji coordinates const buffer = mountFuji.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Mount Fuji // Function to calculate NDSI function calculateNDSI(image) { const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B6']).rename('NDSI'); return image.addBands(ndsi); } // Function to process December data for a given year async function processDecember(year, collectionId) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 11, 1); // December 1st const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year + 1, 0, 1); // January 1st next year let collection = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId) .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(calculateNDSI) .select(['NDSI']); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) return null; // Calculate mean NDSI const meanImage = collection.mean(); const stats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanNDSI = stats.get('NDSI').getInfo(); const pixelCount = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); return {year, meanNDSI, pixelCount, images: count}; } // 2. Process December 2020 (Landsat 8) const ndsi2020 = await processDecember(2020, 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2'); if (!ndsi2020) { console.log("No data for December 2020"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Process December 2005-2015 const historicalNDSI = []; for (let year = 2005; year <= 2015; year++) { let collectionId; if (year <= 2011) { collectionId = 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2'; // Landsat 7 } else { collectionId = 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2'; // Landsat 8 } const result = await processDecember(year, collectionId); if (result) { historicalNDSI.push(result); } } // Check if we have historical data if (historicalNDSI.length === 0) { console.log("No historical data found (2005-2015)"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Validation checks if (ndsi2020.pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2020"); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for invalid NDSI values if (ndsi2020.meanNDSI === null || isNaN(ndsi2020.meanNDSI) || ndsi2020.meanNDSI < -1 || ndsi2020.meanNDSI > 1) { console.log("Invalid NDSI value for 2020"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Compare with historical data console.log(`December 2020: NDSI=${ndsi2020.meanNDSI.toFixed(3)}, Images=${ndsi2020.images}`); let allLower = true; for (const hist of historicalNDSI) { console.log(`December ${hist.year}: NDSI=${hist.meanNDSI.toFixed(3)}, Images=${hist.images}`); if (hist.meanNDSI === null || isNaN(hist.meanNDSI)) { console.log("Invalid historical NDSI value"); console.log("C3"); return; } if (ndsi2020.meanNDSI >= hist.meanNDSI) { allLower = false; } } // 6. Final answer if (allLower) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
